Our Electrical Services

Consumer Units and Rewires

Done Properly, Left Tidy

Why Choose GMW Electrician

Years across domestic, commercial and industrial work mean we know what each job needs. Customers tell us how clean, efficient and courteous we are, and we always leave the working area safe and tidy.

  • Qualified and Registered

    NAPIT registered, City and Guilds 2391 inspection and testing, and an OZEV and Ohme approved installer for EV chargers.

  • Known Brands Only

    Scolmore, Crabtree and JCC fittings, Pod Point and Ohme chargers. No poor quality materials and no rushed installs.

  • Tested and Certified

    Thorough inspection and testing, with the correct certification and notifications for the work.

  • Clean and Courteous

    All mess tidied up and the working area kept safe and tidy, in your home or your workplace.

  • Local to Norwich

    Based in Norwich and working across Norfolk, from Wymondham and Dereham to King's Lynn and Fakenham.

About Us

The Team Behind GMW Electrician

Gary started GMW in 2010 alongside working as a mechanical engineer, having qualified as a mechanical engineer and an electrician in the same month. Wanting a new challenge, he took the business full time in 2012.

Today GMW is one electrician and one builder, with many years in the electrical and construction industry across domestic, commercial and industrial settings. Homeowners, builders and commercial clients all get the same care: planned properly, done with known brands, and left clean and tidy.
